title: Soft & Comfortable
text: Soft & Comfortable. These are quite soft rigt out ofthf package even without washing the brushed microfiber feels great against those parts of my legs that still have feeiling. Diabetic neuropathy is a real annoyance. My biggest problem is these are sold as king size pillowcases but they were next to impossible to get started om my extra firm pillow with a two inch gusseted sidewall. I fought for easily fifteen minutes to get the pillowcase started on the pillow. Someone without nerve damage to the hands, arms and neck might have had an easier time. But I got it on and it fits pretty good. It's much softer than the previous supposedly 100% cotton set that was very rough and crinkled easily. Very happy with the new pillowcase on the new pillow even if it was a project to get started..
